about.description: Soudagar Welfare Trust (SWT) is a community-driven initiative working for social welfare, education, and community harmony.

privacy.membershipDetails: Membership form details are sent to the trust’s Google Apps Script service to process your enquiry. Contact the trust to ask how your details are stored or to request their removal. Only members who choose Yes to public display appear in Our Members. Choosing No includes you in the total count without publishing your name. You can contact the trust to withdraw your permission.
